test_title: PYST 25 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 21 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Choose the correct passive voice transformation of the sentence:**

Who painted the Mona Lisa?

options.text: By whom was the Mona Lisa painted?
Who was the Mona Lisa painted by?
The Mona Lisa was painted by whom?
By whom the Mona Lisa was painted?

solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. By whom was the Mona Lisa painted?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence given in the active voice is “Who painted the Mona Lisa?”</strong
